source.note: Kenney boat-fishing-small (GLB with the kit colormap). Small Japanese fishing boat: height 4.2 m keel to mast tops gives a 6.25 m hull, 2.88 m beam (chunky toy proportions, beam on the wide side). y = 0 is the hull bottom; the waterline sits at about y = 0.45 m (the hull knuckle), so a film sinks the boat 0.45 m into its water plane. White hull, red gunwale and wheelhouse roof (the source blue), dark deck. Static, no clips.
